{{AnimePokémonInfobox |nickname=Chuchu |jnickname=チュチュ |tmnickname=Chuchu |image=[[File:Chuchu.png|200px]] |caption=Yellow's Pikachu |location=[[Viridian Forest]] |gender=Female |nature=Mild |ability={{a|Static}} |type1=Electric |media=special |prevonum=025 f |pokemonname=Pikachu |epnum=PS111 |epname=Tyranitar War |current=[[Party|With Yellow]] |va=no }} '''Chuchu''' (Japanese: '''チュチュ''' ''Chuchu'') is a {{p|Pikachu}} that {{adv|Yellow}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and her seventh {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. Her [[Characteristic]] is that she "likes to run." ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}=== [[File:Pika and Chuchu Egg.png|thumb|left|200px|Chuchu with Pika and their Egg]] [[File:Yellow and Chuchu.png|thumb|150px|Chuchu and Yellow]] Chuchu was {{pkmn2|caught}} about three years after {{adv|Yellow}}'s first appearance in the {{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}. In ''[[PS111|Tyranitar War]]'', Yellow mentions that she found Chuchu injured in [[Viridian Forest]] and took her in. After introducing her to her uncle [[Wilton]], he notes that Chuchu had grown quite attached to her and expounded on his real objective, which was to ask Yellow to go to the [[Johto]] region with him to investigate about {{p|Lugia}}. Because the sheer magnitude of a monster that they are dealing with does not leave him with many options alone, he needed someone to go with him, and Yellow came up with the idea to ask {{adv|Red}}. After Yellow found him training near Viridian Forest, Chuchu seemed to take a liking to [[Pika]] soon after they met. However, with Red's wrists and ankles still weak from the damage that [[Lorelei]]'s ice cuffs left on them, he needed to recover at the hot springs of [[Mt. Silver]], and left Pika behind. Alongside Pika and Yellow, Chuchu flew to Johto on [[Kitty]] with Wilton's {{p|Butterfree}}. In ''[[PS140|Do-Si-Do with Dodrio]]'', they encountered {{adv|Crystal}} after the latter mistook Pika for a wild Pokémon. [[PS142|Soon]], however, the two {{pkmn|Trainer}}s got involved in Lugia's rampage and lost consciousness in the shipwreck. Following the incident, Chuchu and Pika produced an {{pkmn|Egg}} in ''[[PS160|Playful Porygon2]]'' when Pika spent time with her in the Johto [[Pokémon Day Care|Day-Care Center]]. When some [[Team Rocket]] members attacked the Day-Care Center, Chuchu, in a desperate attempt to protect her egg, flew, with the help of balloons, carrying Pika and their Egg. When the [[Masked Man]] took the three hostage near [[Ilex Forest]], {{adv|Gold}} embraced their Egg and took a number of blows to guard it, hatching the {{p|Pichu}} that the Egg contained. With [[Pibu|Pichu]]'s assistance, the boy eventually succeeded in defeating the villain, and Chuchu's offspring was left in his care. ==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}=== [[File:Blue Pidgeot FeatherDance.png|thumb|200px|left|Battling against Blue's Pidgeot]] In ''[[PS287|Secrets from Sneasel]]'', Yellow and Chuchu enter the [[Viridian Gym]] to see if {{adv|Blue}} and Red have returned. They find the Gym empty when suddenly a hologram of Blue appears from behind Yellow. The hologram is revealed to be a pre-recorded message designed to battle challengers even when Blue isn't in town. Chuchu tells Yellow that she wants to fight, so Yellow decides to take the challenge. Blue's {{p|Pidgeot}} starts off the battle with {{m|Feather Dance}} and follows up with {{m|Wing Attack}}. Next, {{p|Alakazam}} is sent out and uses {{m|Role Play}} to copy Chuchu's [[Ability]], {{a|Static}}. Alakazam uses the Ability to paralyze Chuchu, defeating her. [[File:Blue Alakazam Role Play Static.png|thumb|200px|right|Static activated via Role Play]] Through a chain of events, she [[PS299|later]] found herself in Red's hands after Yellow spent the last of her energy informing him of {{adv|Deoxys}}'s message, and assisted in defeating the ten {{p|Forretress}} that [[Carr]] had placed inside the [[Team Rocket airship]] alongside Red's Pokémon and [[Blue's Charizard]]. Afterwards, she returned to her sleeping Trainer. ==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}=== [[PS330|Two months later]], she and Pika, who were thankfully able to escape the beam that left their Trainers petrified, traveled with Gold and Crystal to the [[Hoenn]] region to help save {{p|Jirachi}}. Soon, Gold also revealed that the two and his own Pichu, Pibu, had learned {{m|Volt Tackle}} to help out, and after the remaining five of the [[Pokédex holder]]s succeeded in freeing their comrades, the three dealt the finishing blow to [[Guile Hideout]]'s giant {{p|Kyogre}} monster. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Pika Chuchu Pibu.png|right|thumb|100px|Chuchu, Pika, and Pibu]] Chuchu is a kind and caring Pokémon, much like her {{pkmn|Trainer}}. Chuchu cares greatly for {{adv|Yellow}} and is often the only one of her teammates outside of her {{i|Poké Ball}}. Despite Yellow not being much of a battler, Chuchu is capable of fighting and occasionally insists on participating in battles. Upon meeting [[Pika]], she instantly sparked a connection with him and has since become his mate. Chuchu also cares greatly for her son [[Pibu]]. {{-}} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|Electric||{{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Pika Chuchu Pibu Volt Tackle|1=Chuchu Fly}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Volt Tackle|1=Fly}}}} {{anmov|Flying|Fly|PS173|The Last Battle VII}} {{anmov|Electric|Volt Tackle|PS336|The Final Battle IX}} {{anmov/f|Electric}} ==Trivia== * Just like Pika using {{m|Surf}} as a reference to [[Surfing Pikachu]], Chuchu references [[Flying Pikachu]] by using balloons to {{m|Fly}}. * Chuchu is the only Pokémon currently belonging to Yellow that: ** has not reached her final form. ** is female. ** does not have a nickname ending with y. ** was caught after the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. * In a special memorial illustration by series artist [[Satoshi Yamamoto]], Chuchu is shown with a heart-shaped tail shared by all other female Pikachu, when she was previously depicted without one. ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="float:left; background: #{{electric color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{electric color}}" |- !
